specs.name: isometric-terrain
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric ground tiles atlas for original neighborhood simulation. Make a clean 4-column by 4-row atlas on a truly transparent background, exactly sixteen equal square cells, no labels, no gutters drawn, no scenery. Each cell contains ONE identical-sized flat 2:1 diamond ground tile, centered exactly in its cell, width 90% cell width, height 45% cell width. Tile has zero thickness, no bevel, no drop shadow, perfectly straight diamond edges. Original crisp illustrated pixel-game aesthetic, natural muted colors, coherent warm daylight. Requested canvas 1536x1536. Tile ordering: row1 grass, grass with tiny flowers, pale stone sidewalk, tan gravel path; row2 plain dark asphalt, asphalt road with stripe along diamond axis down-right, asphalt road stripe along diamond axis down-left, cobblestones; row3 wooden floorboards, cream cafe tiles, terracotta floor, pale blue bathroom tile; row4 blue water, brown garden soil, pale sand, grass with scattered leaves. IMPORTANT actual transparency outside each diamond. No checkerboard painted in. Maintain strict equal-cell alignment and a common 2:1 projection.

specs.name: isometric-buildings
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric building sprites atlas for original neighborhood simulation. Create four separate complete building sprites in a precise 2-column by 2-row grid, equal square cells, generous transparent margins. Truly transparent background outside each building. Original cozy contemporary neighborhood, crisp detailed illustrated game art with pixel-like edges, warm natural colors, upper-left lighting. Fixed 2:1 game isometric projection, see front and right walls and rooftops, parallel lines without perspective convergence. Each building stands on a small flat diamond foundation fitting inside its own cell, no surrounding town and no characters. Top-left: cream neighborhood cafe, terracotta tiled roof, sage striped awning, coffee cup pictogram above entrance, large inviting front windows. Top-right: compact brick general store with muted teal roof, produce crates beside door, small blank hanging sign. Bottom-left: warm plaster cottage with green roof and tiny porch. Bottom-right: brick cottage with blue-gray roof and bay window. Each ground footprint approximately a 2:1 diamond, each building same scale, foundation center at cell x=50%, y=77%; entire sprite within cell x=8..92% and y=8..90%. Canvas requested1536x1536. No text, letters, logos, watermark, grid lines, painted checkerboard, or cast shadow extending past the cell. Do not merge adjacent sprites.

specs.name: isometric-props
specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production isometric props sprite atlas. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, equal square cells, 16 separate isolated items on genuinely transparent background. Consistent original cozy neighborhood game art, muted natural palette, crisp illustrated pixel-like edges, upper-left lighting, 2:1 game isometric projection. Each item fully inside its cell with at least10% margin, ground contact centered at x50% y80%. Relative size may differ but each item should be readable. Canvas requested1536x1536. Ordered left to right, top to bottom: row1 leafy broadleaf tree, small leafy tree, rounded flowering shrub, terracotta flower planter; row2 wooden park bench facing down-left, wooden cafe table, wooden chair facing down-left, slim streetlamp; row3 cafe counter with an espresso machine on it, freestanding wooden bookshelf, comfortable blue armchair, single bed with cream pillow and sage blanket; row4 takeaway coffee cup, small sealed delivery parcel, green metal trash bin, wooden notice board with blank cream papers. Strictly no labels, text, grid lines, checkerboard illustration, connected scenery, extra objects outside individual sprites. Keep background transparent.

specs.name: maya
specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 8-direction walking CHARACTER SPRITE SHEET for a 2.5D isometric neighborhood game. Create one original adult character Maya: medium brown skin, dark hair tied in a bun, cream shirt, sage green cafe apron, dark trousers, brown shoes. Friendly proportions with slightly large head, rendered in warm clean illustrated game style with crisp edges matching a cozy isometric town. Camera consistently looks down at her from a fixed elevated isometric angle, approximately 30 degrees above horizontal. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, no scenery, no shadows, no labels, no grid lines, no watermark.
STRICT layout: exactly 4 columns by 8 rows, 32 separate full-body sprites. Every cell same size. Request1024x2048 pixels. Character same height in every cell, center x50%, feet baseline y85%, top of head y15%, keep all body parts within x20..80%. Each row is ONE facing direction and each column one animation pose.
Row1 facing toward viewer (screen south); row2 facing down-left (southwest); row3 facing left (west); row4 facing up-left (northwest); row5 facing away (north, back view); row6 facing up-right (northeast); row7 facing right (east); row8 facing down-right (southeast).
Columns in every row:1 standing idle feet together;2 walking left foot forward right arm forward;3 passing pose feet near together;4 walking right foot forward left arm forward. Do not rotate the camera. Rotate the character only. Each row's four sprites face exactly the SAME direction. All 32 sprites are the SAME PERSON wearing the SAME OUTFIT. Feet anchor must be consistent so a game can animate these frames without sliding. The left-facing rows must actually show left-facing silhouettes, the back row must show the back of her head and apron straps. No additional poses or characters.
